title: identity step 1: re-track our player detections in pitch metres (fixed camera), ignoring the image tracker's ids
owner request: 2026-11-17: distance per player needed; order agreed: pass accuracy, then the identity project step by step
facts before: player_stitch: a player's main track holds 0.29 of his 3 min (2-m matching; 0.34 at 3 m), 17% identity mixing inside tracks; stitching whole fragments fails; with a perfect identity our detections give his distance to ~4-5%
data: the 47 ordinary-play windows; our player detections as stored in metric_v3s_link (the image tracker's kept detections: frame, pitch x / y, kit team team_A / team_B / other); track ids ignored
split: dev matches 117092, 117093, 118575, 118576, 118577 (settings chosen there); test matches 118578, 128057, 128058, 132831, 132877 (reported, settings frozen)
re-tracker (T): frame by frame (every stored frame); each track an alpha-beta filter in metres (alpha 0.5, beta 0.2); Hungarian between active tracks' predictions and the frame's detections, cost = distance + 1.5 m if the detection's kit team differs from the track's (team_A vs team_B) + 0.5 m if the detection is 'other'; allowed if distance <= gate + 7 m/s x time since the track's last hit; a track unmatched for longer than the coast time ends; unmatched detections start tracks; a track's team = the majority of its kit labels
choice on dev: the cell with the highest (continuity median - mixing median)
measures: player_stitch's (continuity, pieces, mixing, distance on the main trajectory's span within 5%), with the truth matched within 3 m (the truth's positions are 1.2-1.7 m off; 2 m also reported)
primary (test matches): continuity median and mixing median of the best of T and T+S, against U
step target: continuity median >= 0.80 with mixing median <= 0.05 on the test matches
what this cannot show: a whole match; appearance cues (the video is not used: step 2 if needed)
